name: Calendar
summary: A month calendar where clicking a day opens a day strip and an hour-by-hour timeline, and dragging across days adds a multi-day event.
useWhen: Showing events in a month and drilling into one day
Scheduling where the time of day matters
People add events that span several days
avoidWhen: People only need to pick a date in a form
Several independent calendars on one page, because the month state is shared globally
A month of events inside a dashboard, where planning/calendar-01 fits better
